Obstacle Relevance

Dynamic relevance scoring system that prioritizes detected objects based on class, distance, and velocity.

Obstacle Relevance Scoring Module.

This module provides functionality for assessing the relevance/danger level of detected obstacles based on their class, distance (depth), and velocity. Calculates both real depth from RealSense depth maps and estimated depth from bounding box size when depth data is unavailable.

The relevance scoring system uses a 1-5 scale where 5 is highest priority (immediate danger) and 1 is lowest priority (distant or low-risk objects).

obstacle_relevance.get_obstacle_relevance_rating(object_class, depth, velocity)[source]

Calculate dynamic relevance rating for a detected object.

Computes a relevance score (1-5) based on object class, distance, and velocity. The base rating comes from the object class, which is then adjusted down for greater distances and up for moving objects.

Distance penalties:

  • ≥7m: -4 to rating

  • ≥5m: -2 to rating

  • ≥3m: -1 to rating

Velocity bonus:

  • 0.6-10 m/s: +2 to rating

Parameters:

  • object_class (str) – The class of the detected object (e.g., “person”, “bin”).

  • depth (float) – The depth/distance to the object in meters.

  • velocity (float) – The object’s velocity in meters per second.

Returns:

The adjusted relevance rating from 0-5, where:

  • 5: Highest priority (immediate danger)

  • 4: High priority

  • 3: Medium priority

  • 2: Low priority

  • 1: Very low priority

  • 0: Filtered out (too far or irrelevant)

Return type:

int

obstacle_relevance.estimate_depth(object_class, bbox)[source]

Estimate object depth from bounding box size.

Uses an inverse square root relationship between bounding box area and distance to estimate depth when RealSense depth data is unavailable. Each object class has a calibrated scale factor based on average real-world sizes from the training dataset.

Formula: depth = object_scale / sqrt(bbox_area)

Parameters:

  • object_class (str) – The class of the detected object.

  • bbox (list[float]) – Bounding box as [x1, y1, x2, y2].

Returns:

Estimated depth in meters, or MAX_DEPTH if area is invalid.

Return type:

float

obstacle_relevance.real_depth(bbox, depth_map)[source]

Calculate real depth from RealSense depth map.

Extracts depth values from the RealSense depth map within the bounding box, filters out invalid readings, and returns the median depth.

Parameters:

  • bbox (list[float]) – Bounding box as [x1, y1, x2, y2].

  • depth_map (numpy.ndarray or None) – RealSense depth map in millimeters, or None if unavailable.

Returns:

Median depth in meters within the bounding box, or MAX_DEPTH if

no valid depth data is available.

Return type:

float

obstacle_relevance.get_object_median_depths(objects, depth_map)[source]

Add depth information to detected objects.

Processes a list of detected objects and adds ‘depth’ field to each using either real depth from RealSense depth map (preferred) or estimated depth from bounding box size (fallback).

Parameters:

  • objects (list[dict]) – List of detected objects, each with ‘bbox’ and ‘class’ fields.

  • depth_map (numpy.ndarray or None) – RealSense depth map in millimeters, or None.

Returns:

Same list of objects with ‘depth’ (float) field added to each,

representing distance in meters.

Return type:

list[dict]
